name: AdaptHealth Corp.
summary: AdaptHealth Corp., together with its subsidiaries, distributes home medical equipment (HME), medical supplies, and home and related services in the United States. It operates through Sleep Health, Respiratory Health, Diabetes Health, and Wellness at Home segments. The company offers sleep therapy equipment, supplies, and related services, such as continuous positive airway pressure and BiLevel services to individuals suffering from obstructive sleep apnea; oxygen and home mechanical ventilation equipment and supplies and related chronic therapy services; and medical devices, including continuous glucose monitors and insulin pumps for the treatment of diabetes; HME to patients discharged from…
